scene: The funicular rattles upward as a clockwork conductor dispenses glowing star tokens.
beats: The warm star token chimes happily in your palm, unlocking the upper hatch just as the funicular docks and its doors glide open.
You tuck away the comet charts found inside the satchel right as the carriage reaches Comet Watch Rooftop and slides open.
Your telescope catches the comet's greenish glow through the glass, just before the funicular halts smoothly and the doors part wide.
picture: Inside a steeply tilted funicular carriage, a brass clockwork conductor stands on the left dispensing tokens. The player stands in centre-left wearing his burnt-orange jacket, beanie, and sling telescope. In centre, an empty wooden bench holds a buckled satchel beneath it. On the right, a wide glass window frames roofs descending below.
shown: a brass clockwork conductor holding out glowing starry tokens on the left
a bulging leather satchel strapped shut beneath an empty bench in centre
a wide arched observation window framing distant city roofs on the right

after.beat: Rattling past the rooftop, a stray spark tickles your sleeve before the terminal switch. You hop into a sidecar motorbike that putters straight to the glowing valves of Midnight Radio Repair.
after.then: Step off at Midnight Radio Repair

variants.scene: Cozy lamps hum inside the wooden tram while a brass automaton offers sparkling stars.
beats: The twinkling token hums pleasantly against your fingers, ready to unlock the upper platform as the funicular eases into its stall and the carriage doors slide apart.
Inside the unbuckled satchel you discover folded comet maps to pocket quickly, right as the ride reaches Comet Watch Rooftop and the wooden doors pull open.
Raising the brass scope to the glass, you spot a faint emerald streak across the skyline right as the tram docks and the exit doors roll open.
variants.ride_on: Rumbling beyond the platform, a stray ember brushes your corduroy jacket before the switch tracks. You transfer into a sputtering sidecar motorbike bound for Midnight Radio Repair.

variants.scene: Gears whir softly as you ride uphill, humming {tune} under glowing carriage lamps.
beats: The bright little star tinkles warmly in your hand, releasing the hatch above just as the funicular brakes at the summit and the entryway opens.
You slide out crisp paper star maps from beneath the empty seat, just as the tram clatters into Comet Watch Rooftop and its heavy doors slide wide.
Your telescope brings the greenish tail of the comet into view through the archway, just as the carriage halts and the doors slide back smoothly.
variants.ride_on: Sailing past the dark roof stop, a bright spark grazes your sleeve near the rail switch. You leap onto a waiting sidecar motorbike that putters to Midnight Radio Repair.

variants.scene: Warm lamplight fills the climbing carriage while a tin robot hands out starry shapes.
beats: The chiming star shines in your grasp, ready for the overhead gate just as the funicular settles at the landing and the double doors open.
You unfasten the abandoned satchel to retrieve detailed comet charts, tucking them away safely as the tram stops at Comet Watch Rooftop and slides open.
Peering past the arched frame, your telescope catches a pale green comet trail before the car glides to a stop and the wide doors open.
variants.ride_on: Coasting beyond the landing, a flick of static hits your coat at the railway switch. You board a noisy sidecar motorbike that putters straight toward Midnight Radio Repair.
